name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters National Tournament attendance card
notes: 400 copies of a single-card promo ("Kanan the Swordmistress") given to attendees of the first Duel Monsters National Tournament (held February 1-21, 1999; card distributed at the February 21 final). This is the earliest dated OCG distribution certified in this ledger, predating Vol.1 by 12 days. "Kanan the Swordmistress" is OCG-only (never released in the TCG) and has no other pre-cutoff source in this ledger.
